dateAudit.dateOnlyClockConvention: No timestamp is invented; date-only bounds also cover unconfirmed source timezones

durationAudit.nonRecordPolicy: Submissions without a documented WR reign have zero credited WR duration; identical player/total WR evidence inherits canonical bounds.
durationAudit.uncertaintyPolicy: Date-only and retrospective evidence produces duration bounds, never an asserted exact reign.

retainedSourceGapPolicy: All71 current worksheet entries have supported dated named reports,43 newly dated. Other-tour worksheet leads and missing original footage retain their explicit limitations.
finalBoardDatePolicy: Accurate OCR with same-row name/time bounding boxes confirms final-board report-publication dates where no earlier supported exact named result is selected. Original submission clocks take precedence where independently supported. Nu11 original upload March21 differs from later Discord submission March23; both retained internally, earliest supported publication used for established record day.
